title: Neurosymbolic Graph Enrichment for Grounded World Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly includes 'Moral Value Driven Coercion' as one of its 11 primary heuristics for knowledge enrichment. It evaluates the ability of LLMs to extract and formalize implicit knowledge related to moral values, ethical considerations, and social norms, and includes a human evaluation component measuring the plausibility of these generated moral assertions.
